description: Zhang Fei, stocky powerful chinese warrior in the supplied pixel art style. Black hair in a top bun, a red headband with long tails, black armor with red plates and gold trim, a gold beast buckle, a red front cloth, dark boots with gold bands. He holds a long spear with a wavy serpent blade, a dark shaft and gold fittings

actions.b1: HORIZONTAL spear sweep, feet planted. Frames 2-6 the whole upper body winds far to the right with the spear held level; frames 7-8 the spear swings around from the side to the front in a wide flat arc; frames 9-11 hold in front. The spear travels sideways, not a thrust.
actions.c5: Pursuit, two thrusts. Frames 1-5 draw back; frame 6 a full thrust; frames 7-9 half a withdrawal; frame 10 a second faster thrust; frames 11-12 hold.

notes: 2차 원화(2026-11-18): 창 140px(측면 실측), 뒷손은 끝에서 34px 기준. 늘어난 12px은 창끝 쪽으로 나간다(weapon_mode forward). 찌르기에서 창끝이 표적 중앙을 12px 지난다. 2026-11-20: 이 PC에서 처음부터 다시 뽑기 위해 원화를 256으로 줄인 사본을 쓰고(원본 1254는 _1254-original), 무기 좌표를 세운 기본 자세 원화에서 다시 쟀다. 이전 설정은 pixellab.before-20261120.json.
face: A fierce broad face with a thick black beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: black hair in a top bun, a red headband knotted at the back with two red tails, black and red armor with gold trim, the long serpent spear at his right side.
guard_action: both hands take the spear and bring it to a ready angle at the right side, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend
